programme.title: Chalte Chalte
programme.desc: Geeta is admitted to a mental hospital after her lover passes away tragically. Later, she gains her senses, only to find him alive and in love with another woman.

programme.title: Madrangi
programme.desc: Deepu, the daughter of a rich businessman, falls in love with her driver Manu. Problems arise when Manu suffers a brain injury and is blamed for the death of an MLA's brother.

programme.title: Ek Aur Prem Deewani

programme.title: Devta

programme.title: Ajab Gazabb Love

programme.title: Khakee: The Real Police
programme.desc: When a drug lord ransoms police officer Diwakar's son for a bag of cocaine, he has no choice but to steal it from police headquarters. However, this raises the suspicions of his colleague Mallika.

programme.title: Maati Maangey Khoon

programme.title: Juaari
programme.desc: Vijay, a young man, resorts to gambling in order to free his lover, Anita, who is held captive by Sanga. He soon runs out of luck when he gets arrested.

programme.title: Koyelaanchal

programme.title: Ek Se Bure Do

programme.desc: Widower Vijay lives in a village with his family. He unwittingly makes an enemy in Lala and a bandit, Bhagad, who conspire and throw him out of the village. But Vijay soon returns as a changed man.

programme.desc: Colonel Puri requests his former fellow army officers court-martialed in disgrace to redeem themselves by rescuing a village from Jageera, an evil bandit.

programme.title: The Flaw
programme.desc: 1955. Crime directed by Terence Fisher. A racing driver (John Bentley) plans to murder his heiress wife (Rona Anderson). The lawyer (Donald Houston) discovers the plot. [S]

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: The Scientist. 1956. Stars Richard Greene, Alan Wheatley & Archie Duncan. A scientist who is being hunted down, after developing a terrifying new weapon, seeks Robin's help. [S]

programme.title: Dial 999
programme.desc: Heads or Tails. 1958. Stars Robert Beatty, Richard Bebb & Raf De La Torre. Released from prison after serving eight years, Bill Weldon sets out to kill the three men who testified against him. [S]

programme.title: Supercar
programme.desc: The Phantom Piper. 1961. Stars Graydon Gould, David Graham & George Murcell. The Supercar team heads to Scotland to investigate reports of a ghostly bagpiper. [S]

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: The Fame and the Fury. 1955. Stars Ron Randell, Patrick Holt & Sandra Dome. Celia's partner is a struggling painter. But when she leaves him for a wealthier man, she soon realises her mistake. [S]

programme.title: The Triumph of Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: 1935. Mystery. Directed by Leslie S. Hiscott. Stars Arthur Wontner, Lyn Harding & Jane Carr. Sherlock Holmes puts his retirement on hold to investigate one last case with his sidekick Dr. Watson. [S]

programme.title: Life in The Past Lane with Noel
programme.desc: Noel visits and opens the Ribbon of Dreams exhibition at the Elstree & Borehamwood Museum celebrating 100 years of Elstree Studios.

programme.title: Battle of the V1
programme.desc: 1958. War. Director: Vernon Sewell. Stars Michael Rennie, Patricia Medina & Christopher Lee. Polish Resistance discover a mysterious pilot-less plane. [S]

programme.title: Z-Cars
programme.desc: Squatters. 1975. Stars Peter Craze, Rio Fanning & John Kane. The council want to evict a commune, but how far is too far when the squatters resist? [S]

programme.title: Saloon Bar
programme.desc: 1940. Thriller. Director: Walter Forde. Stars: Gordon Harker, Elizabeth Allan & Mervyn Johns. A group of pub locals set out to prove that a local is not guilty of murder to prevent a hanging. [S]

programme.title: Richard the Lionheart
programme.desc: The Devil is Unloosed. 1963. Stars Dermot Walsh, Iain Gregory & Sheila Whittingham. Prince John is told by a fortune teller that Richard is dead, so he makes plans to proclaim himself King. [S]

programme.title: Glimpses: London River Bus late 1940s
programme.desc: Take a trip on The Thames from Greenwich, where many of London's historic features are to be seen: Tower Bridge, The Tower Of London, St Pauls, the 'new' Waterloo Bridge & on to Westminster

programme.title: The Man In The Sky
programme.desc: 1957. Drama. Director: Charles Crichton. Stars Jack Hawkins, Elizabeth Sellars & Walter Fitzgerald. John Mitchell is on a flight fraught with disaster but Mitchell is determined to land the plane. [S]

programme.title: The Third Man
programme.desc: 1949. Director: Carol Reed. Stars Orson Welles, Joseph Cotten & Alida Valli. A pulp novelist travels to Vienna only to find himself investigating the sudden death of old friend Harry Lime. [S]

programme.title: Talking Pictures with Hayley Mills
programme.desc: Mike Read sits down with Hayley Mills to discuss her iconic roles in this exclusive Talking Pictures interview. [S]

programme.title: Scales of Justice
programme.desc: 1962. A Woman's Privilege. Starring Bernard Archard, Ann Lynn and Patrick Wymark. Based on a real criminal case, a shipboard romance leads to a lawsuit for breach of promise. [S] (S1, E02)

programme.title: The Footage Detectives
programme.desc: Visit the location of the James Bond film 'A View To Kill' with some behind the scenes footage. After a nostalgic train trip, meet the unique Sinclair C5 and learn about the first vacuum cleaner! [S]

programme.title: Maigret
